title: Children taught physics by 'the ghost'

tellings.quote: I've met with some families where the kids I've been graciously allowed to speak with the kids and the kids have said Well, the the the um the the the ghost comes and tells me.

plain: Some children say a visitor they call "the ghost" comes and teaches them physics. Dave Rossi, a guest who says aliens taught him advanced physics too, says he has met such families and been allowed to talk with the children, who told him, "the ghost comes and tells me." If true, it would mean these lessons are not his alone.
